detailed_descriptions.en: Deep in the jungle of Barkuna lies an untouched ancient civilization. You play as James Thorvaldsson, a seasoned solo explorer. Commissioned by the Relic Hunters Group, he sets off on a mission to retrieve the Great Gem of Barkuna. Explore the jungle-enveloped Jaguar’s Haven, traverse the cliffs high in the mountain of Eagle’s Perch, and unravel the secrets hidden within the lava-filled Serpent’s Hollow. Are you clever enough to solve the puzzles leading to the Great Gem, or will you use raw strength to brute-force your way to untold riches? Relics of Barkuna offers a blend of exploration, puzzle-solving, and a collect-a-thon style of gameplay. FEATURES 3 distinct levels with exploration and puzzle-focused gameplay. Over 240 lost relics. 5 new tools.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Deep in the jungle of Barkuna lies an untouched ancient civilization.
You play as James Thorvaldsson, a seasoned solo explorer. Commissioned by the Relic Hunters Group, he sets off on a mission to retrieve the Great Gem of Barkuna.

Explore the jungle-enveloped Jaguar’s Haven, traverse the cliffs high in the mountain of Eagle’s Perch, and unravel the secrets hidden within the lava-filled Serpent’s Hollow.

Are you clever enough to solve the puzzles leading to the Great Gem, or will you use raw strength to brute-force your way to untold riches?

Relics of Barkuna offers a blend of exploration, puzzle-solving, and a collect-a-thon style of gameplay.

FEATURES
  • 3 distinct levels with exploration and puzzle-focused gameplay.
  • Over 240 lost relics.
  • 5 new tools.
